description: This file defines the MenuLinkTreeElement class, a value object representing an element in a menu link tree within Drupal. It includes properties for menu link data, subtree, depth, active trail status, access rights, and options, along with methods for construction and counting descendant links.

classes.name: MenuLinkTreeElement
classes.description: Represents an element in a Drupal menu link tree, including link data, subtree, depth, and trail status, with methods for counting descendant links.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a MenuLinkTreeElement with link data, child presence, depth, trail status, and subtree.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts all menu links in the current subtree, including descendants.
